title: The Singing Skull
text: A skull on a pole by the road clacks its jaw, singing a marching song in a cracked voice. It knows every verse, some of them very rude. It says it was a soldier once, that it knows the way, and that it is very bored.

options.label: Take it along as a guide; a bored soldier still knows the roads.

outcomes.text: It sings you down a better road.
It sings you down a road it likes better.

options.label: The wisest learns its song, every verse, even the rude ones.

outcomes.text: It is a good song, and it sticks. The march goes easier for it.

options.label: Smash the skull and let the soldier rest at last.

outcomes.text: It goes on singing from the pieces, quieter.
